notes.title: Patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
In the last update, there was a problem with our save system.

This has now been fixed!

To apologise for this inconvenience, we are giving you all:

[b]Rewards:[/b]
- 10000 Orbs
- 1 common chest
- 1 unusual chest
- 1 rare chest
- 1 legendary chest


[b]Fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Storage system
[/list]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] SteamCloud
[*] Button "Hover" effect
[/list]

notes.title: Information about Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
We have unfortunately found a problem with our saving system in our latest update. This means that the old saves are no longer loaded.

This affects all players who played before patch [b]v1.0.1.[/b]
New players are not affected!

We are already working on a new patch to solve the problem. But unfortunately, we can't promise if we can save the old data.

With the next update, all players will get [b]compensation[/b] for this inconvenience!

We thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
mh-studios
